body.intent: Fix Test temp folders leak and fill the disk: TestMain in internal/api/budget_test.go removes the generated rhiza-api-budget-* model (~146MB) only when the test binary exits normally, so every go test timeout (common under load) leaves one behind; quiettest leaves rhiza-quiet-* the same way, and slice/index budgets their own. On the VM 124 budget folders (~18GB) and 369 quiet folders piled up in TMPDIR by 2026-11-04 and the disk fell to 19GB free. Have each package remove its own stale folders (older than an hour, by prefix) when it starts, or put them under one per-run directory make test deletes, and test it
